text:
lina_csm: dropping a tiny 'Quickstarter' runbook we gave a fintech pilot today. Purpose: fast go-live checklist for smoothing cold-starts + a short renewal triage. copyable for 5m preflight.

omar_eng: paste the 6-point readout so i can paste to the portal pls.

zoe_onboard: 6-point Quickstarter (read in call):
1) warmpool_target = 8 for first 2h.
2) prefill prefix_cache: top 25 prefixes.
3) seed long-tail for top 5 users.
4) set stream_fallback_ms = 750 (p50 first-token).
5) ensure headers: X-Client-Queue, X-Session-Hint, X-Idempotency-Key.
6) enable feedback webhook at 24h + 7d.

henry_sre: ops rule clarifier: flip to non-stream after 4 p50 misses in 12m. warmpool_miss_rate >4% over 10m -> create ticket.

omar_eng: minimal curl snippet for customers:
```
curl -H "X-Client-Queue: tenant-$T" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

lina_csm: renewal-triage (quick): usage drop >=30% + p95 latency up by >=150ms + negative 24h feedback -> assign AM + "stabilize" playbook.

zoe_onboard: enablement cadence we read: kickoff, 24h activation check, 72h perf check, 7d adoption review. log decisions in playbook card.

henry_sre: tiny prelaunch emulator we run (copyable):
```
seq 1 200 | xargs -n1 -P10 curl -s -H "X-Client-Queue: tenant-$T" -d '{}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate &>/dev/null
```

tool-bot: Playbook created: https://board.redwood.internal/play/99871 tags=[quickstarter, warmpool, fallback] :white_check_mark:

lina_csm: i'll add owners and a Day-2 quick sync. flag any missing bits and i'll update the card. thanks!
